title: Renewal-Exposure Uplift: Auto-Renewals That Try Account Credit First
content:
> Harborline Customer Accounts. Reads the customer's Web Hosting Plans and Domain Registrations holdings.

**Rule.** The renewal-exposure uplift of the late-posting goodwill follows the renewals that try the account credit first: where the customer holds an active hosting plan with auto-renew on, it adds $3.00; where it holds no such plan but holds an active domain with auto-renew on, it adds $1.50; otherwise it adds nothing. The uplift is a fixed sum added to the late-posting goodwill figure.

**Q&A.**

- *Active hosting plan with auto-renew off, active domain with auto-renew on?* $1.50: the plan is not one with auto-renew on.
- *Active hosting plan with auto-renew on and active domains with auto-renew on?* $3.00 only.
- *No active holding with auto-renew on?* Nothing.
